_readme: EMC x TSC1/TSC2, ROUND 8, 2026-08-24 -- a quality check on the denominator that could bias the rate DOWNWARD, which is the direction that matters for a route this file might otherwise close. The one TSC2-positive sample is MATCHED_STATUS = 'Unmatched', so its somatic call is inferred by filtering rather than demonstrated. MATCHED_STATUS is a PER-SAMPLE field, so the cohort-level description 'matched tumour-normal' does not hold for every sample, and the question this raises is not about that one sample: IF A LARGE SHARE OF THE 75 WERE SEQUENCED WITHOUT A MATCHED NORMAL, then germline-looking variants will have been filtered out aggressively, and TSC1/TSC2 truncating variants are exactly the class such a filter can discard. That would make the measured rate an UNDER-estimate, and 'the route is closed because the rate is low' would be the wrong conclusion drawn from a filtering artefact. GENE_PANEL is fetched alongside it because the panel-coverage control so far establishes that TSC1 and TSC2 are on every IMPACT panel VERSION; it does not establish which version each of the 75 actually ran. A sample on some other panel entirely would be a hole in the denominator.
